You send up sighs to the Father on high for your agony and for His. But who can know, who can feel, the rage that tears me? Who can know my fear and the tremble of my heart? Who but you, sweet Mother? Wherever I go, what woe, what woe, what woe, I feel in my heart! Alone, I weep, I weep, and I weep, till my heart is torn. At dawn when I picked these flowers, the pots at my window were wet with my tears. The sun shines into my room so brightly, and I sit on my bed engulfed in agony. Lady! Mother! Help me! Save me from disgrace and death! Mother of sorrows, behold me in my distress.

@@U01721@@
The street in front of 格蕾琴’ door. 瓦伦丁, a soldier, 格蕾琴’ brother.

@@U01723@@
Time was I'd sit drinking with the boys, listening to them boast about their girls, and wash it down with another drink or two. There I sat, smiling, stroking my chin at all their big talk.
translation:
@@U01719@@
你为你和他的痛苦而向高天之父发出叹息。但谁能知道，谁能感受，让我流泪的愤怒？谁能知道我的恐惧和我内心的颤抖？亲爱的妈妈，除了你还有谁？无论我走到哪里，我心里都感到何等的悲哀，何等的悲哀，何等的悲哀！我独自一人哭泣，哭泣，哭泣，直到我的心被撕裂。黎明时分，当我采摘这些花时，窗前的花盆都被我的泪水打湿了。阳光如此明亮地照进我的房间，我坐在床上，痛苦万分。女士！母亲！帮我！救我脱离耻辱和死亡！悲伤之母，请看我的痛苦。

@@U01721@@
格蕾琴门前的街道。 瓦伦丁，一名军人，格蕾琴的兄弟。

@@U01723@@
有时我会和男孩们一起喝酒，听他们吹嘘自己的女儿，然后再喝一两杯。我坐在那里，微笑着，听着他们的大话，抚摸着下巴。
